findings.title: Blocking call in async function
findings.explanation: The async function `wait_until_ready` uses `time.sleep`, which blocks the event loop and prevents other async tasks from running during the sleep period. This can cause performance degradation and deadlocks in an async application.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `time.sleep(2**attempt)` with `await asyncio.sleep(2**attempt)` and import asyncio at the top of the file.

findings.title: Blocking sleep in async function
findings.explanation: Using time.sleep inside an async function blocks the event loop, preventing other coroutines from running. The idiomatic approach is to use await asyncio.sleep for non-blocking delays.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `time.sleep(2**attempt)` with `await asyncio.sleep(2**attempt)` and remove the unnecessary import of `time`.
